chapter_title_en: The Winds Rise Overseas — Wind and Thunder United
chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Ch. 557: The Patient Gambler Counts Down
chapter_meta_description: Han Li is forced to serve as a wood-element battery for the Wind Lightning Wings. But as the three demons near exhaustion, his cold calculation begins—the next moment of weakness is his window.
og_title: Ch. 557 – Wind Lightning Wings Finale: The Demons’ Exhaustion Clock
og_description: Imprisoned and tagged with a restraint spell, Han Li runs the numbers on when to strike as three ancient demons burn their last trump card.
twitter_title: Han Li’s hostage job just got a deadline.
twitter_description: Three demons, one bone-wing treasure, and a restrained cultivator counting down their mana pool. The quietest chapter is the most dangerous setup.

lore_anchors.definition: A control technique implanted into a subordinate’s body, allowing the caster to inflict excruciating pain by channeling magic power into it; it is a standard leash in the cultivation world’s master-subordinate dynamic.
A highly concentrated, naturally aged liquid form of spiritual energy; consuming one drop can instantly replenish a severely depleted mana pool, making it a battlefield-grade consumable.
A property of a magical treasure that naturally purges evil qi and demonic contamination from its wielder's body without requiring active activation.
A dual-element treasure that fuses wind and thunder properties, granting the wielder both extreme speed and lightning-based destructive capabilities.
